ابرغشوا (form IVq)
# اِبْرَغَشُّوا (ibraḡaššū) /ib.ra.ɣaʃ.ʃuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِبْرَغَشَّ (ibraḡašša)
# اِبْرَغِشُّوا (ibraḡiššū) /ib.ra.ɣiʃ.ʃuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِبْرَغَشَّ (ibraḡašša)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
